description: Agent-based diffusion-of-adoption model with social influence, policy broadcasts, and heterogeneous thresholds on a homophilic social network. Suitable for fitting to daily adoption and opinion time series and evaluating policy scenarios.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the social network with homophily and assigns groups; initializes Person agents and edge weights.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day == 0:
  set RNG seed = global.random_seed
  create groups = range(group_count)
  assign each person to a group uniformly (or per block sizes)
  if network_topology == 'watts_strogatz':
    G = watts_strogatz_graph(n=population_size, k=round(mean_degree), p=rewiring_prob)
  elif network_topology == 'barabasi_albert':
    G = barabasi_albert_graph(n=population_size, m=preferential_attachment_m)
  else: # stochastic_block
    construct SBM with homophily_strength controlling intra-block edge probs
  rewire or weight edges to achieve assortativity_target approximately
  for each edge (i,j): assign weight ~ Normal(weight_mean, weight_std), clipped to [0,1]
  initialize person attributes (opinion, thresholds, susceptibility, stubbornness) from specified distributions
  set adopted=True for a random fraction initial_adopter_fraction of persons
notes: Assortativity can be nudged via degree-preserving swaps targeting group assortativity.

modules.name: PolicyBroadcast
modules.description: Schedules and broadcasts policy messages and enforcement to agents, producing per-person policy influence and penalties.

update_rule.pseudocode:
policy_influence = zeros(population_size)
penalties = zeros(population_size)
messages_sent = 0
if day % campaign_frequency_days == 0:
  total_messages = round(policy_intensity * budget_per_day)
  messages_to_priority = round(total_messages * fraction_to_priority_group)
  messages_to_others = total_messages - messages_to_priority
  select recipients from priority_group_id uniformly for messages_to_priority
  select recipients from non-priority groups uniformly for messages_to_others
  for each recipient r:
    delta = message_effectiveness * exp(-last_message_effect[r] * message_decay_rate)
    policy_influence[r] += delta
  messages_sent = total_messages
# Enforcement
for each person i:
  if random() < compliance_enforcement_prob:
    penalties[i] = enforcement_penalty
# Decay last_message_effect
for each person i:
  last_message_effect[i] = max(0, last_message_effect[i] * (1 - message_decay_rate) + policy_influence[i])
output signals: policy_influence, penalties, messages_sent
notes: Enforcement penalty increases effective hazard of adopting or reduces threshold via AdoptionDecision.

modules.name: OpinionDynamics
modules.description: Updates agent opinions via weighted social averaging with bounded confidence, policy influence, noise, and forgetting.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  neighbors = N(i)
  weighted_sum = 0; weight_total = 0
  for j in neighbors:
    if abs(opinion[j] - opinion[i]) <= bounded_confidence_epsilon:
      w = edge_weight(i,j) * (1 - trust_variance*0.5 + trust_variance*random_uniform(0,1))
      weighted_sum += w * opinion[j]
      weight_total += w
  social_term = opinion[i] if weight_total==0 else weighted_sum/weight_total
  policy_term = signal.policy_influence_per_person[i]
  new_opinion = stubbornness * opinion[i] + influence_weight_social * (social_term - opinion[i]) + influence_weight_policy * policy_term
  new_opinion = new_opinion * (1 - forgetting_rate) + opinion_initial_mean * forgetting_rate
  new_opinion += Normal(0, noise_std)
  # misinformation shock for a fraction of agents
  if random() < misinformation_fraction:
    new_opinion = clip(new_opinion - misinformation_bias, 0, 1)
  opinions_next[i] = clip(new_opinion, 0, 1)
# Social norm perceived by each agent as neighbor mean opinion
for each i:
  social_norm[i] = mean(opinion[j] for j in N(i)) if |N(i)|>0 else mean(opinions_next)
update opinions = opinions_next
notes: Bounded-confidence ignores neighbors too far in opinion.
Forgetting drifts toward initial mean capturing exogenous reversion.

modules.name: AdoptionDecision
modules.description: Converts opinions and social norms to adoption events via a hazard-based threshold mechanism with fatigue and relapse.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_events = []
for each person i:
  if adopted[i]:
    # Relapse with probability depending on fatigue
    if random() < relapse_rate * fatigue[i]:
      adopted[i] = False
    else:
      fatigue[i] = min(1.0, fatigue[i] + fatigue_rate)
    continue
  # Compute persuasion score
  persuasion = opinions[i] * 0.5 + social_norm[i] * 0.5 + signal.enforcement_penalty_per_person[i]
  # Effective threshold lowered by enforcement
  effective_threshold = adoption_threshold[i] - signal.enforcement_penalty_per_person[i]
  margin = persuasion - effective_threshold
  hazard = max(0, hazard_rate_base + hazard_rate_sensitivity * (persuasion_to_adoption_slope * margin))
  hazard = 1 - exp(-hazard)  # map to probability in [0,1)
  # Intrinsic propensity adds baseline
  p_adopt = clip(hazard + intrinsic_adoption_propensity, 0, 1)
  if random() < p_adopt:
    adopted[i] = True
    fatigue[i] = max(0, fatigue[i] * 0.5)
    adoption_events.append(i)
# Initialization day (day==0): set a random fraction initial_adopter_fraction to adopted=True and record events
notes: Hazard formulation yields smooth probability mapping.
Fatigue accumulates while adopted and increases relapse risk.

modules.name: AggregationObserver
modules.description: Computes daily observables for calibration and evaluation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day % observe_every_n_days != 0: return
adoption_rate_daily = mean(adopted[i] for i in persons)
mean_opinion_daily = mean(opinions[i] for i in persons)
messages_sent_daily = sum(log.messages_sent[today])
for each group g:
  adoption_rate_by_group[g] = mean(adopted[i] for i in persons if group[i]==g)
cumulative_adoption = cumulative_adoption_prev + sum(1 for i if adoption_event_today(i))
store observables with timestamps
apply rolling_window_days smoothing if needed for reporting
notes: By-group observable aligns with group-level calibration.
Smoothing can be toggled by setting rolling_window_days.

algorithms.HomophilicNetworkGeneration: Construct WS/BA/SBM graphs; adjust assortativity via edge swaps; set weighted edges from Normal(weight_mean, weight_std) clipped to [0,1].
algorithms.BoundedConfidenceDeGroot: Weighted social averaging over neighbors within epsilon; add policy term, forgetting, and noise; clip to [0,1].
algorithms.HazardAdoption: Compute persuasion margin; hazard = 1 - exp(-(base + sensitivity * slope * margin)_+); Bernoulli draw for adoption; fatigue-modulated relapse.
algorithms.PolicyMessageScheduler: Periodic broadcasting with targeted allocation and diminishing returns via message decay; random enforcement with penalties.
